rule: plan 90 §90.3.1 with design general/topics/relevant, howdecided, prominent, howto, workup/choose; keys = signed EORS im general (SD_GEN_ALL: labs, ekg, imaging, anatomy, procedures, guidelines, screenings, workup); PAEA Internal Medicine 2026 topic list (scratch/im/im-2026.pdf); Leader S10 ruling: selection recorded here, general.json written in S12

labs.why: Lab interpretation is needed for most IM-list conditions (anemias, coagulation disorders, acid-base and electrolyte disturbances, AKI/CKD, diabetes, thyroid/adrenal disorders, hepatitis, HIV…), far over the ≥3 bar; her guide has lab-heavy content (Hepatitis B serology table, Acid/Base Disorders, SODIUM/POTASSIUM/CALCIUM tables).

items.item: CBC with indices (MCV, RDW), reticulocyte count and peripheral smear
items.covers: Anemias; Thalassemias; Sickle cell disease; G6PD deficiency; Leukemias; Polycythemia (her guide: HEME tables, CBC reference image)

items.item: Iron studies, B12 and folate (methylmalonic acid, homocysteine)
items.covers: Anemias (microcytic, macrocytic, anemia of chronic disease)

items.item: Hemoglobin electrophoresis
items.covers: Thalassemias; Sickle cell disease (her guide: electrophoresis and hemoglobin-type images)

items.item: Coagulation studies: PT/INR, aPTT, fibrinogen, D-dimer, platelet count; HIT antibodies
items.covers: Coagulation disorders (DIC, ITP, TTP, von Willebrand disease, hemophilia); Deep vein thrombosis; Pulmonary embolism

items.item: Basic/comprehensive metabolic panel: sodium, potassium, calcium, phosphate, magnesium, BUN/creatinine, glucose
items.covers: Electrolyte disturbances; Disorders of calcium and phosphorous; Acute kidney injury; Chronic kidney disease; Diabetes mellitus

items.item: Arterial blood gas and acid-base interpretation (anion gap, expected compensation)
items.covers: Acid-base disturbances; Acute respiratory failure; Diabetic ketoacidosis; Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (her guide: Acid/Base Disorders note and table)

items.item: Urinalysis with microscopy, urine culture; urine protein/albumin-to-creatinine ratio; FENa
items.covers: Cystitis; Pyelonephritis; Nephritic and nephrotic syndrome; Acute kidney injury; Uro/Nephrolithiasis; Diabetic nephropathy

items.item: Hemoglobin A1c, fasting glucose, OGTT; serum ketones
items.covers: Diabetes mellitus; Diabetic ketoacidosis; Hyperosmolar hyperglycemic syndrome

items.item: Lipid panel
items.covers: Lipid disorders; Coronary artery disease; Diabetes mellitus

items.item: TSH, free T4, T3; thyroid antibodies; PTH
items.covers: Hyper/Hypothyroidism; Thyroiditis; Thyroid storm; Myxedema coma; Hyper/Hypoparathyroidism

items.item: Adrenal and pituitary testing: cortisol (dexamethasone suppression, ACTH stimulation), aldosterone/renin ratio, plasma metanephrines, IGF-1, prolactin, water deprivation test
items.covers: Adrenal insufficiency; Hypercortisolism; Hyperaldosteronism; Pheochromocytoma; Acromegaly; Diabetes insipidus; SIADH

items.item: Liver panel (AST/ALT, alkaline phosphatase, bilirubin, albumin), lipase
items.covers: Hepatitis; Cirrhosis; Cholecystitis; Cholangitis; Pancreatitis

items.item: Hepatitis serologies (HBsAg, anti-HBs, anti-HBc, HBeAg; HAV, HCV)
items.covers: Hepatitis (her guide: Hepatitis B Serology table)

items.item: Cardiac troponin and BNP/NT-proBNP
items.covers: Acute coronary syndrome; Heart failure; Myocarditis

items.item: Inflammatory markers and autoantibodies: ESR/CRP, ANA, anti-dsDNA, RF, anti-CCP, ANCA, complement, CK
items.covers: Systemic lupus erythematosus; Rheumatoid arthritis; Vasculitides; Polymyalgia rheumatica; Polymyositis; Sjögren syndrome

items.item: Synovial fluid analysis (cell count, crystals, Gram stain/culture)
items.covers: Gout/Pseudogout; Septic arthritis; Rheumatoid arthritis

items.item: Blood cultures, lactate, procalcitonin
items.covers: Sepsis; Septic shock; Bacteremia; Infective endocarditis; Neutropenic fever

items.item: HIV testing (4th-generation Ag/Ab), CD4 count and viral load
items.covers: Human immunodeficiency virus/AIDS; Opportunistic infections

items.item: Tumor and myeloma markers: serum/urine protein electrophoresis, free light chains, PSA, CEA, AFP
items.covers: Multiple myeloma; Neoplasms (prostate, colorectal, hepatocellular)

ekg.why: Cardiovascular is 20% of the IM list and her IM guide has a full arrhythmia block (sinus, AV blocks, AFIB/AFL, AVNRT/AVRT/WPW, PAC/PVC, VT, torsades, VFIB, BBB); EKG findings are needed for ≥3 IM-list conditions.

items.covers: Arrhythmias/Conduction disorders

items.covers: Heart blocks (her guide: BBB & Fascicular Block row)

items.covers: Premature beats (her guide: PAC, PVC rows)

items.covers: Ventricular arrhythmias (her guide: VT, Torsades, VFIB rows)

items.covers: Electrolyte disturbances (hyper/hypokalemia, hypo/hypercalcemia); Arrhythmias (drug-induced torsades)

items.item: Echocardiography (transthoracic/transesophageal)
items.covers: Heart failure; Cardiomyopathy; Valvular disorders; Infective endocarditis; Pericardial effusion; Pulmonary hypertension

items.item: Cardiac stress testing and coronary angiography
items.covers: Coronary artery disease; Stable angina; Acute coronary syndrome

items.item: Non-contrast head CT; MRI brain; CT/MR angiography

items.item: Adrenal cortex zones and medulla with their hormones

items.item: Cardiac conduction system and auscultation points

items.item: Nephron segments and the sites of diuretic action
items.covers: Electrolyte disturbances; Acid-base disturbances; Renal disease

items.item: Hepatobiliary and portal venous anatomy
items.covers: Biliary tract disorders; Cirrhosis; Portal hypertension; Esophageal varices

items.item: Arthrocentesis
